intended_object: Given an R-linear map f : M → N with N I-adically complete, this is the extension of f to the I-adic completion M̂ → N, defined as the completed map M̂ → N̂ followed by the inverse of the isomorphism N ≅ N̂. It is the universal property of the completion. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the lemmas `extend_of` and `extend_comp_of`.
